title: Level 1&2 Sound Healing Course at Bali Yoga School
metaTitle: Level 1&2 Sound Healing Course in Bali Indonesia
metaDescription: This Sound Healing course is ideal for people who want to understand healing techniques through Tibetan singing bowls therefore want to teach as a teacher to others.
summary: Take Level 1 and Level 2 sound healing at the same time, learning the therapeutic use of sound through practical and theoretical sessions.
intro: This course is for you if you want to get level 1&2 sound healing courses at the same time. Our school is located in a peaceful area surrounded by the lush tropical palm trees and rice fields, offering a perfect environment to dive into the transformative world of sound and to connect more deeply with yourself.

This sound healing course is thoughtfully crafted to guide you through the therapeutic use of sound, using instruments like Tibetan singing bowl, gongs, ocean drum, happy drum, rain sticks, and your own voice. You’ll learn how to use the instruments to heal target parts of the body or emotions, and even chakras. Whether you are new to sound healing or wish to deepen your existing practice, this course will give you more than a foundation level of the world of sound healing.

Our dedicated teachers will be with you every step of the way, sharing their expertise and insights through both practical and theoretical sessions. You will dive into the science behind sound healing, understanding its effects on the body and mind, and discover techniques to use sound as a powerful healing modality for yourself and others.
durationStatements: Length of the Course: 4 days & 3 Nights

curriculum.title: Level 1 Syllabus
items: Introduction to Tibetan sound healing therapy and its benefits
Concept and types of singing bowls
How to select the singing bowls
Technique to hold the bowls
Technique to rub and hit the bowls
Introduction to the concept of Aura, how to clean and seal the Aura
Aura protection for yourself
Mind relaxing technique
Therapy for digestive system
Water charging technique and its benefits in drinking
How to facilitate a professional healing
Safety rules for conducting the session

curriculum.title: Level 2 Syllabus
items: Detailed introduction about the chakras
Identifying and clearing blocked chakras using bowls
Using sound to cleanse and clear your space
7 chakra therapy and chakra balancing
Mental therapy
Physical therapies
7 chakra balancing, inclusive of all chakras
